claims.text: FBI authorised destruction of master video 1B60 (June 2024, 'no longer pertinent'; prosecutor concurred Aug 2024); 2025 re-recording lost 62 seconds; Bondi's nightly-reset explanation untested; full footage released by Congress Sept 2025 shows nothing unusual in that minute.
NYT (June 2026) concluded suicide; Tartaglione said he warned guards; Reyes warned he 'was not good to be left alone'; no replacement cellmate; found dead within 24 hours of Reyes leaving.
Noel told House Oversight (18 May 2026) she believes he killed himself; transfers 'had nothing to do with Epstein'; $5,000 deposit 10 days before; searched 'latest on Epstein in jail' ~40 min before.

Inmate FBI interview (handwritten 302) claims he heard officers talk of a cover-up; unsubstantiated; DOJ found no inmate with credible information otherwise; three inmates with line of sight said no one entered.
Baden (Oct 2019), hired by Mark Epstein, said injuries more consistent with homicide; chief medical examiner Sampson stood by hanging/suicide.

Freeman (Oregon Health & Science / Maastricht; editor JFLM) reviewing ME file from Mark Epstein; says no scene photos, ligature not preserved; to present at UCL 16 Nov 2026; has not disclosed conclusion.

claims.text: Brunel found dead in his Paris cell 19 Feb 2022, held since Dec 2021 on charges of raping minors, after several suicide attempts in prison; official probe concluded 2023; his lawyers asked (Dec 2023) for an inquiry, saying the judiciary failed to account for his high suicide risk.

Giuffre died by suicide April 2025 north of Perth, aged 41; WA police commissioner announced (24 Jun 2026) a review of officers' handling of her domestic dispute; family and 16 experts sought a coronial inquest; coroner/ombudsman could act.

Andriesz, who raised concerns about BGC and Lutnick–Epstein links with the FCA, FBI and others, died in Thailand 23 Sep 2026; no official cause reported; family: suicide, no indication of foul play; FCA appointed Lea Paterson to review its handling.

Siad found dead 20 Jul 2026 at home in Colombes, 69; autopsy: no recent violence, old heart attack; Nanterre closed probe 22 Oct 2026 for lack of criminal offence, no toxic cause, cardiac condition; he had wanted to be heard; faced complaints including rape, denied.
Hoffenberg, 77, found Aug 2022 in Derby, Connecticut, dead at least a week; autopsy found no trauma; no sign of struggle or forced entry.
Reyes found dead 27 Nov 2020; reportedly after contracting COVID-19 (NYPD via NY Daily News).

Middleton died 7 May 2022 in Perry County, Arkansas; family court petition and authorities: suicide; brother said depression worsened; PolitiFact rated 'murdered' claim False; Daily Mail's first report said no weapon, follow-up reported a weapon found.

Shapiro, Columbus lawyer whose firm represented Wexner's The Limited, shot dead in 1985 the day before he was due to testify in a tax-fraud case; unsolved; in 1996 the police chief was investigated and accused of ordering a report on the case destroyed.
